title: Cycle Detection in Directed Graph (DFS)
intuition: Directed: 3-color DFS (active path stack) or Kahn leftover nodes.

approaches.title: DFS 3-color
Kahn leftover
approaches.idea: If topo cannot include all nodes ⇒ cycle.
approaches.code:
from collections import defaultdict, deque

def has_cycle_kahn(n, edges):
    g = defaultdict(list)
    indeg = [0] * n
    for u, v in edges:
        g[u].append(v)
        indeg[v] += 1
    q = deque([i for i in range(n) if indeg[i] == 0])
    seen = 0
    while q:
        u = q.popleft()
        seen += 1
        for v in g[u]:
            indeg[v] -= 1
            if indeg[v] == 0:
                q.append(v)
    return seen != n
